translations.literal: Henan once recruited fighting men, but for the most part they were idle, lazy market folk untrained in drill.
translations.idiomatic: Henan once recruited fighters, but they were mostly idle townspeople with no training.

sentences.zh: 若遷簽驅丁監戶數千，別為一軍，立功者全戶為良，必將爭先效命以取勝矣。

translations.literal: If several thousand relocated conscript laborers and supervised households were formed into a separate army, with whole households made commoners for merit, they would surely compete to give their lives first and win.
translations.idiomatic: Form a separate army from thousands of relocated conscripts and supervised households—free whole families for merit—and they will fight to win.

sentences.zh: 武衛軍家屬嘗苦於兵，人人懷憤，若擇驍悍千餘，加以爵賞，亦可得其死力。」

translations.literal: Martial Guard families had suffered from warfare and each harbored anger; if more than a thousand fierce men were chosen and given ranks and rewards, their utmost strength could also be obtained."
translations.idiomatic: Martial Guard families hated the war; pick a thousand bold men, reward them, and they will die for you."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「老病之官，例許致仕，居河北者嫌于避難，居河南者苟於屍祿，職事曠廢。

translations.literal: He also said: "Officials old and ill are routinely permitted to retire; those in Hebei are suspected of fleeing hardship, those in Henan cling to salary without work, and duties lie vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Sick and aged officials should retire—Hebei men stay to avoid fleeing, Henan men cling to salary, and offices go undone.

sentences.zh: 乞遍諭核實，其精力可用者仍舊，年高昏聵不事事者罷之。」

translations.literal: I beg a general order to verify: those whose vigor can still be used remain; those advanced in years, muddled and deaf, who attend to nothing—remove them."
translations.idiomatic: Review every office: keep the able, dismiss the senile who do nothing."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「賦役頻煩，河南百姓新強舊乏，諸路豪民行販市易，侵土人之利，未有定籍，一無庸調，乞權宜均定。

translations.literal: He also said: "Taxes and corvée are frequent; Henan commoners newly strong and old depleted; powerful men of the circuits travel trading, encroaching on natives' profits, with no fixed registers and no corvée at all—I beg an expedient equalization.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes crush Henan; wealthy itinerant traders evade registers and corvée—equalize this by expedient rule.

sentences.zh: 如知而輒避、事過複來者，許諸人捕告，以軍興法治之。」

translations.literal: If knowing they deliberately evade and return after the affair passes, allow all to capture and report them and punish by wartime law."
translations.idiomatic: Let anyone denounce those who dodge duty and return later; punish them under wartime law."

sentences.zh: 詔下尚書省議，惟老病官從所言，餘皆不允。

translations.literal: The edict was sent to the Masters of Writing for deliberation; only the proposal on old and ill officials was accepted; the rest were denied.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing approved only the proposal on sick officials; all else was rejected.

sentences.zh: 大元兵圍東平，弼百計應戰，久之，乃解圍去。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops besieged Dongping; Bi used every stratagem to meet the fighting; after a long time they lifted the siege and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces besieged Dongping; Bi fought by every means until the siege lifted.

sentences.zh: 宣宗賜詔，獎諭將士，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong bestowed an edict praising officers and soldiers; rewards were graded.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rewarded officers and soldiers in graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 是歲五月，疽發於腦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of that year an abscess broke out in his brain.
translations.idiomatic: That fifth month a brain abscess struck him.

sentences.zh: 詔太醫診視，賜禦藥。

translations.literal: An edict ordered imperial physicians to examine him and bestowed imperial medicine.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial physicians were sent and court medicine given.

sentences.zh: 俄卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died.

sentences.zh: 弼平生無所好，惟喜讀書，閒暇延引儒士，歌詠投壺以為常。

translations.literal: Bi had no hobbies in life except love of reading; in leisure he invited Confucian scholars and made singing, verse, and pitch-pot his regular pastime.
translations.idiomatic: Bi cared only for books; in leisure he gathered scholars and passed time with verse and pitch-pot.

sentences.zh: 所辟如承裔、陀滿胡士門、紇石烈牙吾塔，皆立方面功。

translations.literal: Those he recruited, such as Chengyi, Tuoman Hushimen, and Hesilie Yayuta, all achieved merit on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Men he promoted—Chengyi, Tuoman Hushimen, Hesilie Yayuta—all won frontier honors.

sentences.zh: 治東平，愛民省費，井邑之間，軍民無相訟，有古良將之風焉。

translations.literal: Governing Dongping he loved the people and economized expenses; between towns and villages army and people did not sue one another—he had the air of ancient good generals.
translations.idiomatic: Ruling Dongping he spared the people and expenses; soldiers and civilians rarely sued one another—like the good generals of old.

sentences.zh: 蒙古綱

translations.literal: Meng Gugang
translations.idiomatic: Meng Gugang

sentences.zh: 蒙古綱，本名胡裏綱，咸平府猛安人。

translations.literal: Meng Gugang, original name Huligang, was a man of the Xianpingfu meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Gugang, original name Huligang, came from the Xianpingfu meng'an.

sentences.zh: 承安五年進士，累調補尚書省今史，除國子助教。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the fifth year of Cheng'an, was repeatedly transferred and appointed clerk of the Masters of Writing, and was made assistant instructor of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: A Cheng'an year five jinshi, he served as a Masters of Writing clerk and national university assistant instructor.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，自請招集西山兵民，進官一階，賜錢二百萬，遷都水監丞，尋加遙授永定軍節度副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he volunteered to gather western mountain soldiers and people, was promoted one rank, given two million in cash, transferred to Vice Director of the Directorate of Waterways, and soon given the remote appointment of deputy military commissioner of Yongding Army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he volunteered to rally western mountain troops and people, gained a rank, two million cash, a waterways post, and remote deputy Yongding army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 招捕有功，遷太子左諭德，除順州刺史，遷同知大興府事。

translations.literal: For merit in recruitment and capture he was transferred to Left Mentor of the Heir Apparent, appointed prefect of Shunzhou, and transferred to Acting Administrator of Daxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Recruitment merit made him left mentor to the heir, Shunzhou prefect, then acting administrator of Daxing.

sentences.zh: 三年，知河間府事，權河北東路宣撫使，屯冀州。

translations.literal: In the third year he administered Hejian Prefecture, acted as Pacification Commissioner of Hebei East Circuit, and encamped at Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year three he ran Hejian, acted as Hebei east pacification commissioner, and camped at Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 軍食不足，徙濟南。

translations.literal: Army provisions were insufficient and he moved to Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Short of rations, he moved to Jinan.

sentences.zh: 綱欲徙河南，行至徐州，未渡河，尚書省奏：「東平宣撫使完顏弼行事多不盡。」

translations.literal: Gang wished to move to Henan; reaching Xuzhou before crossing the river, the Masters of Writing memorialized: "Dongping Pacification Commissioner Wanyan Bi's conduct is often incomplete."
translations.idiomatic: Gang meant to move to Henan; at Xuzhou the Masters of Writing reported that Dongping pacification commissioner Wanyan Bi was failing in duty."

sentences.zh: 乃以綱權山東宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Thereupon Gang was made Acting Pacification Vice Commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Gang was made acting Shandong pacification vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改山東路統軍使，兼知益都府事，權元帥右都監，宣撫如故。

translations.literal: He was changed to Military Commissioner of Shandong Circuit, concurrently Administrator of Yidu Prefecture, Acting Right Overseer of the Marshalate, with pacification duties unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: He became Shandong military commissioner and Yidu administrator, acting right marshal overseer, keeping pacification duties.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，行元帥府事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year he conducted the affairs of the Marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, tenth month, he ran the marshalate.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「山東兵後，楊安兒黨內有故淄王習顯、故留守術羅等家奴，不在赦原，據險作亂，至今未息，民多歸之，乞普賜恩宥。」

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "After warfare in Shandong, among Yang An'er's partisans are bond-servants of the former Prince of Zi Xixian and former Protector Shiluo, not within the amnesty—holding perilous ground and making trouble, still unresting to this day, with many people joining them—I beg a universal grant of grace."
translations.idiomatic: Gang wrote: "After Shandong's wars, bond-servants of the former Prince of Zi and Protector Shiluo among Yang An'er's men still hold the hills—grant a general amnesty."

sentences.zh: 宣宗即命赦之，仍贖為良。

translations.literal: The emperor at once ordered them pardoned and still ransomed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned them and allowed ransom to free status.

sentences.zh: 興定三年，奏曰：「濟南介山東兩路之間，最為沖要，被兵日久，雖與東平鄰接，不相統屬，緩急不相應，乞權隸本路，且差近於益都。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Xingding he memorialized: "Jinan lies between the two Shandong circuits and is most strategically critical; long under arms, though adjacent to Dongping it is not subordinate—in urgency it does not respond—I beg that it be temporarily attached to this circuit, being also nearer to Yidu."
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding year three he wrote: "Jinan lies between the two Shandong circuits and is vital; though near Dongping it answers to no one in crisis—attach it to this circuit, closer to Yidu."

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: The edict agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「恩州武城縣艾家凹水濼，清河縣澗口河濼，其深一丈，廣數十裏，險固可恃。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "The Aijia'ao marsh of Wucheng County in Enzhou and the Jiankou River marsh of Qinghe County are one zhang deep and several tens of li wide—perilous and firm enough to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: Gang reported marshes at Wucheng in Enzhou and Qinghe—ten feet deep, miles wide—strong natural defenses.

sentences.zh: 因其地形，少加浚治，足以保禦。

translations.literal: According to their terrain, with slight dredging and improvement, they suffice for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Light dredging would make them defensible.

sentences.zh: 請遷州民其中，多募義軍以實之。」

translations.literal: I beg to move prefectural people into them and recruit many righteous armies to fill them."
translations.idiomatic: Move civilians in and fill the sites with militia."

sentences.zh: 綱以山東恃東平為重鎮，兵卒少，守城且不足，況欲分部出戰，是安坐以待困也。

translations.literal: Gang held that Shandong relied on Dongping as a great stronghold, but with few soldiers—even defending the city was insufficient, let alone dividing forces to campaign; this was sitting at ease awaiting exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: Gang knew Shandong leaned on Dongping, yet had too few men even to hold the walls—sending detachments out was inviting defeat.

sentences.zh: 乃上奏曰：「伏見貞祐三年古裏甲石倫招義軍，設置長校，各立等差，都統授正七品職，副統正八品，萬戶正九品，千戶正班任使，謀克雜班，仍三十人為一謀克，五謀克為一千戶，四千戶為一萬戶，四萬戶為一副統，兩副統為一都統，設一總領提控。

translations.literal: He then memorialized: "Your servant observes that in the third year of Zhenyou Gulijia Shilun recruited righteous armies, established company leaders, and set graded ranks: commander-in-chief given seventh-rank office, deputy commander eighth rank, ten-thousand-household chief ninth rank, thousand-household chief regular rank for appointment, company chief mixed rank—still thirty men to one company chief, five company chiefs to one thousand-household chief, four thousand households to one ten-thousand-household chief, forty thousand households to one deputy commander, two deputy commanders to one commander-in-chief, with one overall commander set.
translations.idiomatic: He cited Zhenyou year three, when Gulijia Shilun organized militia with graded ranks from company chief through commander-in-chief and an overall commander.

sentences.zh: 今乞依此格募選，以益兵威。」

translations.literal: Now I beg to recruit and select by this pattern to increase military might."
translations.idiomatic: Recruit by that pattern to strengthen the army."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 是歲，益都桃林寨總領張林號「張大刀」，據險為亂，自稱安化軍節度使。

translations.literal: That year Zhang Lin, overall commander of Taolin Stockade in Yidu, called "Zhang the Big Blade," held perilous ground in rebellion and styled himself Military Commissioner of Anhua Army.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhang Lin of Yidu's Taolin stockade, nicknamed "Zhang the Big Blade," rebelled on rough ground and styled himself Anhua army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「林勢甚張，乞遣河南馬軍千人，單州經略司以眾接應。」

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "Lin's power is very great—I beg that a thousand Henan cavalry be sent and the Danzhou frontier office support with troops."
translations.idiomatic: Gang asked for a thousand Henan cavalry and Danzhou frontier support."

sentences.zh: 左司郎中李蹊請令綱約燕寧同力殄滅，單州經略使完顏仲元分兵三千人同往。

translations.literal: Left Department Director Li Xi asked that Gang join Yan Ning in combined effort to exterminate them; Danzhou Frontier Commissioner Wanyan Zhongyuan divided three thousand men to go together.
translations.idiomatic: Director Li Xi wanted Gang and Yan Ning to cooperate; Danzhou commissioner Wanyan Zhongyuan sent three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 宰相以糧運不給，益都以東，嘯聚不止一張林，宜令綱設備禦，俟來春議之。

translations.literal: Chief ministers held that grain transport could not be supplied; east of Yidu bandits gathered—not only Zhang Lin—and Gang should prepare defenses and wait until next spring to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers said supplies were short and rebels abounded beyond Yidu—let Gang defend and wait until spring.

sentences.zh: 四年，張林侵掠東平，綱遣元帥右監軍行樞密院事王庭玉討之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zhang Lin raided Dongping; Gang sent Right Marshal Overseer conducting Privy Council affairs Wang Tingyu to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In year four Zhang Lin raided Dongping; Gang sent right marshal overseer Wang Tingyu against him.

sentences.zh: 至舊縣，遇張林眾萬餘人據嶺為陣，庭玉督兵逾嶺搏戰。

translations.literal: Reaching Jiuxian he met more than ten thousand of Zhang Lin's men arrayed on a ridge; Tingyu urged troops over the ridge to grapple in battle.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiuxian he met over ten thousand of Lin's men on a ridge and charged over it.

sentences.zh: 林眾少卻，且欲東走。

translations.literal: Lin's masses gave ground slightly and were about to flee east.
translations.idiomatic: Lin's force gave ground and tried to flee east.

sentences.zh: 庭玉踵擊，大破之，殺數千人，生擒張林，獲雜畜兵仗萬計。

translations.literal: Tingyu pursued and struck, utterly defeated them, killed several thousand, captured Zhang Lin alive, and seized livestock and weapons beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Tingyu pursued, shattered them, killed thousands, captured Lin alive, and seized vast loot and arms.

sentences.zh: 招降虎窟諸寨，悉令歸業。

translations.literal: He recruited the stockades of Huku and ordered all to return to their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified the Huku stockades and sent people back to their trades.

sentences.zh: 詔賜空名宣敕，聽綱第功遷賞。

translations.literal: An edict granted blank-name appointment documents, allowing Gang to grade merit and promote rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Blank appointment patents let Gang reward men by merit.

sentences.zh: 遣樞密院令史劉顒蒞殺張林于東平。

translations.literal: A Privy Council clerk Liu Yong was sent to supervise Zhang Lin's execution at Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council clerk Liu Yong oversaw Lin's execution at Dongping.

sentences.zh: 張林乞貰死自效，請曰：「臣兄演在宋為統制，有眾三千，駐即墨、萊陽之境，請以書招之，使轉致諸賊之款密者，相為表裏，然後以檄招益都張林，不從則合擊之，山東不足平也。」

translations.literal: Zhang Lin begged pardon for his life to serve, saying, "Your servant's elder brother Yan is a Song commander with three thousand men stationed on the borders of Jimo and Laiyang—I beg to summon him by letter, have him relay secret submissions from other rebels, act inside and outside together, then summon by proclamation the Zhang Lin of Yidu who holds the prefecture—if he does not submit, strike jointly; Shandong would not be hard to pacify."
translations.idiomatic: Lin begged for his life and offered: "My brother Yan commands three thousand Song troops near Jimo and Laiyang—recruit him, turn rebel secrets, then summon the other Zhang Lin at Yidu—or crush him—and Shandong will fall."

sentences.zh: 所謂益都張林，即據府事逐田琢者也，事見琢傳。

translations.literal: The so-called Zhang Lin of Yidu is the one who seized the prefectural office and drove out Tian Zhuo—the affair is seen in Zhuo's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The other Zhang Lin of Yidu is the man who seized the yamen and drove out Tian Zhuo—see Zhuo's biography.

sentences.zh: 綱以林策請於朝，樞密院請羈縻使之。

translations.literal: Gang submitted Lin's plan to court; the Privy Council asked to keep him on loose rein and employ him.
translations.idiomatic: Gang forwarded the plan; the privy council favored keeping Lin on a loose leash.

sentences.zh: 制可，以為萊州兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: Approval was granted; he was made seal-holder of Laizhou forces.
translations.idiomatic: Approved—Lin became Laizhou forces seal-holder.

sentences.zh: 久之，山東不能守，林乃降于宋雲。

translations.literal: Before long Shandong could not be held, and Lin then surrendered to Song Yun.
translations.idiomatic: When Shandong could no longer be held, Lin surrendered to Song Yun.

sentences.zh: 初，東平提控鄭倜生擒宋將李資，綱奏賞倜。

translations.literal: Earlier, Dongping Commander Zheng Tong captured alive the Song general Li Zi; Gang memorialized to reward Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Dongping commander Zheng Tong captured the Song general Li Zi alive; Gang asked to reward him.

sentences.zh: 宰臣謂：「李資自稱宋將，無所憑據，請詳究其實。」

translations.literal: Chief ministers said, "Li Zi calls himself a Song general without supporting evidence—I beg that the facts be investigated in detail."
translations.idiomatic: Ministers said Li Zi claimed to be a Song general without proof—investigate first."

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「臣自按問俱獲宋將統制十餘人，皆以資為將無異辭。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "Your servant personally interrogated and together captured more than ten Song commander-regiment leaders; all agreed without difference that Zi was their general.
translations.idiomatic: Gang replied: "I interrogated over ten captured Song commanders—they all identified Zi as their general.

sentences.zh: 此輩力屈就擒，豈肯虛稱偽將，以重獲者之功？

translations.literal: These men, their strength spent, were captured—would they falsely call someone a fake general to magnify the captor's merit?
translations.idiomatic: Defeated captives would not invent a fake general to inflate their captor's credit.

sentences.zh: 今多故之際，賞功後時，將士且解體。

translations.literal: Now in a time of many emergencies, rewarding merit comes late, and officers and soldiers will moreover fall apart.
translations.idiomatic: In such troubled times, delayed rewards will dissolve the army's morale.

sentences.zh: 凡行賞必求形跡，過為逗遛，甚未可也。」

translations.literal: Whenever rewards are given one must seek visible traces—excessive dallying, truly not acceptable."
translations.idiomatic: Insisting on proof for every reward only breeds delay—that will never do.

sentences.zh: 詔即賞之。

translations.literal: An edict immediately rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered an immediate reward.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「遼東渡海，必由恩、博二州之間，乞置經略司鎮撫。」

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "To cross the sea to Liaodong one must pass between En and Bo prefectures—I beg to establish a strategic commissionerate to pacify and govern."
translations.idiomatic: Gang wrote: "Liaodong crossings must pass between En and Bo—I beg a strategic commissionerate there."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 興定五年二月，東平解圍，宣宗曲赦境內。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year of Xingding, Dongping's siege was lifted; Emperor Xuanzong granted a limited amnesty within the borders.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Xingding 5, Dongping was relieved and Xuanzong pardoned the region within limits.

sentences.zh: 凡東平府試諸科中選人，嘗被任使，已逾省試期日，特免省試。

translations.literal: All candidates selected in the various categories at the Dongping prefectural examination who had once been employed and had passed the provincial examination date were specially exempted from the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Dongping examination winners already in service past the provincial exam date were exempt from the provincial round.

sentences.zh: 惟經童律科即為及第，似涉太優，別日試之。

translations.literal: Only the classics-youth and statutory-law categories were made immediate passes—seeming overly generous; they would be tested on a separate day.
translations.idiomatic: Only the classics-youth and law tracks could skip to passing at once—too generous—so they were tested separately.

sentences.zh: 皆從綱所請也。

translations.literal: All followed what Gang had requested.
translations.idiomatic: All followed Gang's requests.

sentences.zh: 詔以綱、王庭玉、東莒公燕甯保全東平，各遷一階。

translations.literal: An edict because Gang, Wang Tingyu, and Duke of Dongju Yan Ning had preserved Dongping promoted each one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gang, Wang Tingyu, and Duke of Dongju Yan Ning were each promoted one rank for saving Dongping.

sentences.zh: 是歲，燕寧戰死。

translations.literal: That year Yan Ning died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yan Ning fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「甯所居天勝寨，乃益都險要之地。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "The Tiansheng Stockade where Ning dwelt is a perilous and vital place of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: Gang wrote: "Ning's Tiansheng stockade is a vital strongpoint of Yidu.

sentences.zh: 甯嘗招降群盜胡七、胡八，用為牙校，委以腹心，群盜皆有歸志。

translations.literal: Ning once induced the bandit chiefs Hu Seven and Hu Eight to submit, employed them as ya-commanders, entrusted them as inner intimates, and the bandits all had a mind to return.
translations.idiomatic: Ning had turned bandit leaders Hu Seven and Hu Eight into trusted ya-commanders, and the outlaw bands were ready to come over.

sentences.zh: 及甯死，複懷顧望，胡七、胡八亦反側不安。

translations.literal: When Ning died they again harbored hesitation and looking-back; Hu Seven and Hu Eight also were restless and uneasy.
translations.idiomatic: After Ning's death they wavered again, and Hu Seven and Hu Eight grew restless.

sentences.zh: 臣以提控孫邦佐世居泰安，眾心所屬，遂署招撫使。

translations.literal: Your servant because Commander Sun Bangzuo had long dwelt at Tai'an and the people's hearts turned to him then appointed him Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: I appointed Tai'an native Commander Sun Bangzuo pacification commissioner—the men trust him.

sentences.zh: 以提控黃摑兀也充總領，副之。

translations.literal: Commander Huang Zhuaye was made overall leader to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Huang Zhuaye served as his deputy overall leader.

sentences.zh: 此當先奏可，顧事勢危迫，故輒授之。」

translations.literal: This ought first to have been memorialized for approval, but seeing the situation urgent, I therefore presumptuously granted it."
translations.idiomatic: I should have sought approval first, but the crisis forced my hand."

sentences.zh: 燕寧死而綱勢孤矣。

translations.literal: Yan Ning died and Gang's position was isolated.
translations.idiomatic: With Yan Ning dead, Gang stood alone.

sentences.zh: 綱奏請移軍于河南，詔百官議，御史大夫紇石烈胡失門以下皆曰：「金城湯池，非粟不守。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized asking to move the army to Henan; an edict ordered the hundred officials to discuss; Censor-in-Chief Geshilie Hushimen and those below all said: "A golden city and boiling moat—without grain cannot be held.
translations.idiomatic: Gang asked to shift the army to Henan; the court debated; Censor-in-Chief Geshilie Hushimen and others said, "Walls of gold and moats of boiling water still need grain to hold.

sentences.zh: 東平孤城，四無應援，萬一失之，則官吏兵民俱盡。

translations.literal: Dongping is a lone city with no support on four sides; if by any chance it is lost, then officials, soldiers, and civilians will all perish.
translations.idiomatic: Dongping is isolated—lose it and officials, troops, and people perish together.

sentences.zh: 宜徙之河南，以助防秋。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to move it to Henan to help guard against the autumn raids.
translations.idiomatic: Move them to Henan to reinforce the autumn defense."

sentences.zh: 翰林待制抹撚阿虎德奏曰：「車駕南遷，恃大河以為險。

translations.literal: Hanlin Attendant-graduate Monian Ahude memorialized: "The imperial carriage moved south, relying on the great river as peril.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin attendant Monian Ahude objected: "The court moved south trusting the Yellow River as its shield.

sentences.zh: 大河以東平為籓籬，今乃棄之，則大河不足恃矣。

translations.literal: The great river takes Dongping as screen and fence; now abandoning it, the great river is not sufficient to rely upon.
translations.idiomatic: Dongping was the river's bulwark—abandon it and the river is no shield.

sentences.zh: 兵以將為主，將以心為主，蒙古綱既欲棄之，決不可使之守矣。

translations.literal: Armies take generals as master, generals take the heart as master; Meng Gugang already wishes to abandon it—decidedly he cannot be made to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: Troops follow their commander and commanders follow their hearts—if Gang means to abandon Dongping, he must not be left to hold it.

sentences.zh: 宜就選將士之願守者擢用之，別遣官為行省，付以兵馬鎧仗，從宜規畫軍食。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to select from among officers and soldiers those willing to defend and promote them; separately send an official as branch secretariat, entrust troops, horses, and armor, and plan military provisions as circumstances permit.
translations.idiomatic: Choose willing defenders, send a separate branch-secretary chief with arms and supplies, and let him arrange rations as needed."

sentences.zh: 樞密院請用胡失門議，焚其樓櫓廨舍而徙之。

translations.literal: The Privy Council asked to use Hushimen's proposal, burn its towers, covered bridges, and offices, and move.
translations.idiomatic: The privy council favored Hushimen's plan—to burn the fortifications and evacuate.

sentences.zh: 宣宗曰：「此事朕不能決擇，眾議可者行之。」

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong said: "In this matter We cannot decide and choose; whichever the assembly's discussion approves, carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong said, "I cannot decide this alone—do what the majority approves."

sentences.zh: 樞密院頗采阿虎德議，許綱內徙，率所部女直、契丹、漢軍五千人，行省邳州。

translations.literal: The Privy Council largely adopted Ahude's proposal, permitted Gang to move inward, and leading his detachments of Jurchen, Khitan, and Han troops—five thousand men—branch-secretariat at Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The privy council mostly took Ahude's side, let Gang withdraw with five thousand Jurchen, Khitan, and Han troops, and posted him at Pizhou.

sentences.zh: 元帥左監軍王庭玉將余軍屯黃陵岡，行元帥府事。

translations.literal: Marshal Left Overseer Wang Tingyu led the remaining army to camp at Huangling Hill and conducted marshalate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal left overseer Wang Tingyu held Huangling Hill with the remainder and ran the marshalate.

sentences.zh: 於是，綱改兼靜難軍節度使，行省邳州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Gang was changed to concurrent Jingnan Army military commissioner and branch-secretariat at Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gang became concurrent Jingnan commissioner and Pizhou branch secretary.

sentences.zh: 自此山東事勢去矣。

translations.literal: From this time Shandong's strategic situation was lost.
translations.idiomatic: From that moment Shandong was effectively lost.

sentences.zh: 是歲六月，以歸德、邳、宿、徐、泗乏軍食，詔綱率所部就食睢州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of that year, because Guide, Pi, Su, Xu, and Si lacked military provisions, an edict ordered Gang to lead his detachments to forage at Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That sixth month, Guide, Pi, Su, Xu, and Si ran short of rations, so Gang was ordered to feed his troops at Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「宿州連年饑饉，加之重斂，百姓離散。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "Suzhou for successive years has had famine; added to heavy exactions, the common people have scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Gang wrote: "Suzhou has faced famine year after year, and heavy levies have driven the people away.

sentences.zh: 鎮防軍遽征逋課，窘迫陵辱有甚於官，眾不勝其酷，皆懷報復之心。

translations.literal: Garrison-defense troops hastily collected overdue taxes; oppression, insult, and humiliation exceeded the officials; the multitude could not endure the cruelty—all harbored thoughts of revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops suddenly collected arrears and bullied the people worse than the civil authorities—everyone seethed with payback in mind.

sentences.zh: 近日，高羊哥等苦其佃戶，佃戶憤怒，執羊哥等投之井中。

translations.literal: Recently Gao Yangge and others harshly treated their tenant farmers; the tenants grew furious, seized Yangge and the rest, and threw them into a well.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Gao Yangge and others abused their tenants until the tenants seized them and threw them down a well.

sentences.zh: 武夫不識緩急，乃至於此。

translations.literal: Fighting men did not know urgency and delay—thus reaching this point.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers who grasp neither urgency nor restraint have come to this.

sentences.zh: 乞一切所負並令停止，俟夏秋收成征還，軍人量增廩給，可也。」

translations.literal: I beg that all debts be altogether ordered stopped, to wait until summer and autumn harvests to collect repayment, and soldiers' rations be increased in measure—acceptable."
translations.idiomatic: Stop all collections now, resume after the harvest, and modestly increase troops' rations—that should suffice."

sentences.zh: 詔議行之。

translations.literal: An edict deliberated and carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved and enacted it.

sentences.zh: 元光二年三月，以邳州經略司隸綱，令募勇敢，收復山東。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Yuanguang, the Pizhou strategic commissionerate was placed under Gang, ordered to recruit the brave and recover Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanguang 2, third month, Pizhou's strategic office was put under Gang to raise brave men and retake Shandong.

sentences.zh: 初，碭山首領數人，以減罷懷忿怨，誘脅餘眾作亂，引水環城以自固，構浮橋於河上，結紅襖賊為援。

translations.literal: Initially several Dangshan chieftains, because of reductions and dismissals harbored resentment, induced and coerced the remaining multitude to rebel, led water to encircle the city to fortify themselves, built a pontoon bridge on the river, and linked with Red-Cloak rebels as aid.
translations.idiomatic: At first several Dangshan leaders, angry over cuts and dismissals, rallied the rest into revolt, flooded moats around their town, bridged the river, and allied with Red-Cloak rebels.

sentences.zh: 同簽樞密院事徒單牙剌哥會諸道兵討之。

translations.literal: Co-signatory Privy Councillor Tushan Yalage assembled troops from all circuits to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council co-signatory Tushan Yalage gathered forces from every circuit against them.

sentences.zh: 綱雲：「碭山北近大河，南近汴堤，東西二百里，大河分派其間，幹灘泥淖，步騎俱不可行，惟宜輕舟往來。

translations.literal: Gang said: "Dangshan is north near the great river, south near the Bian embankment, two hundred li east and west; the great river divides and disperses among it; dry shoals and muddy sloughs—foot and horse both cannot pass; only light boats back and forth are fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Gang said Dangshan lies between the Yellow River and the Bian dyke for two hundred li, with channels and mudflats impassable to infantry and cavalry—only light boats will serve.

sentences.zh: 可選銳卒數千與水軍埽兵，以舟二百艘，由便道斷浮梁，絕紅襖之援。

translations.literal: One may select several thousand crack soldiers with naval troops and barrier soldiers, with two hundred vessels, by a convenient route sever the pontoon bridge and cut off Red-Cloak aid.
translations.idiomatic: Send several thousand elite troops and naval barrier crews in two hundred boats by the shortest route to cut the pontoon and isolate the Red Cloaks.

sentences.zh: 募膽勇有口辯者，持牒密諭之以離間其黨，與臣已遣三人入賊中。

translations.literal: Recruit men of daring courage with skill in debate, holding documents to instruct them secretly to sunder their faction, and your servant has already sent three men into the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Recruit bold, eloquent agents with sealed orders to split their ranks—I have already sent three men inside.

sentences.zh: 複分兵屯要害，別以三百人巡邏。

translations.literal: Again divide troops to garrison strategic points; separately assign three hundred men to patrol.
translations.idiomatic: Post detachments at key points and set three hundred men to patrol.

sentences.zh: 乞賜空名告身，從便遷賞。」

translations.literal: I beg to be granted blank-name credentials, to promote and reward as convenience allows.
translations.idiomatic: Grant blank appointment warrants so I may reward men on the spot."

sentences.zh: 樞密院奏：「已委監軍王庭玉駐歸德、寧陵備之矣。

translations.literal: The Privy Council memorialized: "We have already entrusted Overseer Wang Tingyu to garrison at Guide and Ningling to guard against it.
translations.idiomatic: The privy council reported Wang Tingyu already stationed at Guide and Ningling on guard.

sentences.zh: 仍令牙剌哥水陸並進，先行招誘，不從，乃合擊之。

translations.literal: Moreover order Yalage to advance by land and water together, first to induce surrender; if they do not comply, then jointly strike.
translations.idiomatic: Yalage would advance by land and river, offer terms first, and attack only if they refused.

sentences.zh: 其空名告身，宜從所請，以責成功。」

translations.literal: The blank-name credentials should follow the request, to hold them responsible for success."
translations.idiomatic: The blank warrants should be granted as requested, to drive success."

sentences.zh: 無何，碭山賊夜襲永城縣，行軍副總領高琬、萬戶麻吉擊走之，殺傷及溺死者甚眾，奪其所俘掠而還。

translations.literal: Before long Dangshan rebels by night raided Yongcheng County; Campaign Deputy Overall Leader Gao Wan and Ten-Thousand-Household Maji beat them back, killing and wounding and drowning many, and recovered what they had seized and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Dangshan rebels raided Yongcheng by night; deputy commander Gao Wan and commander Maji drove them off with heavy casualties and recovered the booty.

sentences.zh: 詔綱並力討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Gang to combine forces and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Gang was ordered to press the campaign with full force.

sentences.zh: 綱遣降人陳松持牒招李全，全縛松將斬之，已而但黥其面遣還。

translations.literal: Gang sent the surrendered man Chen Song holding documents to induce Li Quan; Quan bound Song intending to behead him, then only tattooed his face and sent him back.
translations.idiomatic: Gang sent defector Chen Song with a summons to Li Quan; Quan bound him for execution, then only branded his face and released him.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「全有歸國意，嚴實、張林亦可招之。」

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "Quan has a mind to return to the state; Yan Shi and Zhang Lin can also be induced."
translations.idiomatic: Gang wrote that Li Quan wished to return, and Yan Shi and Zhang Lin could be won over too."

sentences.zh: 此謂益都張林也。

translations.literal: This refers to the Zhang Lin of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: This meant the Zhang Lin of Yidu.

sentences.zh: 詔擬實一品官職，封國公，仍世襲。

translations.literal: An edict proposed for Shi first-rank office, enfeoffment as state duke, and moreover hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Shi was to receive first-rank office, a ducal state fief, and hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 全階正三品、職正二品。

translations.literal: Quan's rank was regular third grade, office regular second grade.
translations.idiomatic: Quan was given rank 3a and office 2a.

sentences.zh: 林山東西路宣撫使兼知益都府事，與全皆賜田百頃。

translations.literal: Lin was Shandong East-West Circuit pacification commissioner and concurrent Yidu prefect; with Quan each was granted a hundred qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: Lin became east-west Shandong pacification commissioner and Yidu prefect; he and Quan each received a hundred qing of land.

sentences.zh: 受命往招者先授正七品官職，賜銀二十五兩，事成遷五品。

translations.literal: Those ordered to go induce them were first granted regular seventh-grade office and twenty-five liang of silver; when the affair succeeded they were promoted fifth grade.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were pre-appointed to rank 7b with twenty-five liang of silver, rising to 5b on success.

sentences.zh: 會綱遇害而止。

translations.literal: It happened that Gang met with violence and ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Gang's murder ended the effort.

sentences.zh: 綱禦下嚴，信賞必罰，邳州軍不樂屬綱。

translations.literal: Gang governed subordinates strictly, believing in rewards and certain punishments; Pizhou troops were not pleased to belong to Gang.
translations.idiomatic: Gang ruled harshly with strict rewards and punishments, and the Pizhou garrison resented him.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，邳州從宜經略使納合六哥、都統金山顏俊率沂州軍士百余人晨入行省，殺綱及僚屬于省署，遂據州反。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the first day of the eighth month, Pizhou Flexible Strategic Commissioner Nahe Liuge and Commander-in-Chief Jinshan Yan Jun led more than a hundred Yizhou soldiers at dawn into the branch secretariat, killed Gang and his staff in the secretariat offices, and then seized the prefecture in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, Pizhou commissioner Nahe Liuge and commander Yan Jun of Jinshan led over a hundred Yizhou troops at dawn into the branch yamen, murdered Gang and his staff, and seized the city in revolt.

sentences.zh: 樞密院奏請出空名宣敕，設重賞招誘。

translations.literal: The Privy Council memorialized asking to issue blank-name proclamations and edicts, establish heavy rewards, and induce surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The privy council asked for blank edicts and heavy bounties to lure defectors.

sentences.zh: 丞相高汝礪曰：「懸重賞募死士，必有能取之者。」

translations.literal: Chancellor Gao Ruli said: "Suspend heavy rewards to recruit dare-to-die men—there must be those able to take him.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Gao Ruli said, "Offer a rich bounty for daredevils—someone will bring him in."

sentences.zh: 宣宗不得已，下詔罪綱，以撫諭六哥。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong with no alternative issued an edict blaming Gang to pacify and instruct Liuge.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong, with no choice, condemned Gang by edict to placate Liuge.

sentences.zh: 六哥遣人送綱屍及虎符牌印，終不肯出。

translations.literal: Liuge sent men delivering Gang's corpse and tiger tally, plaque, and seal, but to the end would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: Liuge sent Gang's body and the tiger tally and seals, but still refused to surrender.

sentences.zh: 乃升經略司為元帥府，加六哥泗州防禦使，權元帥左監軍，副使烏古論老漢加邳州刺史，權右監軍。

translations.literal: Thereupon the strategic commissionerate was elevated to a marshalate; Liuge was added Defender of Sizhou, Acting Marshal Left Overseer; Vice Commissioner Wugulun Laohan was added Prefect of Pizhou, Acting Right Overseer.
translations.idiomatic: The strategic office became a marshalate; Liuge became Sizhou defender and acting left overseer; Wugulun Laohan became Pizhou prefect and acting right overseer.

sentences.zh: 頃之，邳州卒逃歸，詣總帥牙吾塔言，六哥已結李全為助。

translations.literal: Before long a Pizhou soldier escaped and returned, went to Commander-in-Chief Hesheli Yawuta and reported that Liuge had already joined Li Quan as help.
translations.idiomatic: Soon a Pizhou deserter told commander Hesheli Yawuta that Liuge had enlisted Li Quan.

sentences.zh: 遣總領孛術魯留住等毀其橋樑，攻破承安、青陽寨，留兵戍守。

translations.literal: He sent Overall Leader Bishilu Liuzhu and others to destroy their bridges and beams, storm Chengan and Qingyang stockades, and leave troops to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He sent overall leader Bishilu Liuzhu to destroy their bridges and take Chengan and Qingyang stockades, leaving garrisons behind.

sentences.zh: 六哥惶懼，乃言待李全兵入邳州，誘而殺之，以圖報效。

translations.literal: Liuge was fearful, then said he would wait for Li Quan's troops to enter Pizhou, lure and kill them, to seek repayment of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, Liuge claimed he would lure Li Quan's men into Pizhou and kill them to prove his loyalty.

sentences.zh: 宣宗曰：「李全豈無心者，六哥能誘而殺之，殆詐耳。」

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong said: "Li Quan—how could he be without cunning? That Liuge can lure and kill him is probably deception.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong said, "Li Quan is no fool—if Liuge can lure and kill him, that is probably a ruse."

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，牙吾塔圍邳州，急攻之。

translations.literal: On renchen in the tenth month, Hesheli Yawuta besieged Pizhou and pressed the attack urgently.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth month's renchen day, Hesheli Yawuta besieged Pizhou and stormed it fiercely.

sentences.zh: 紅襖賊高顯等殺六哥，函首以獻。

translations.literal: Red-Cloak rebels Gao Xian and others killed Liuge, boxed the head and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Red-Cloak rebel Gao Xian and others killed Liuge and presented his head in a box.

sentences.zh: 詔加顯三品官職，授世襲謀克，侯進四品，陳榮、邢進、邊全、魏興、孫仲皆五品，賞銀有差。

translations.literal: An edict promoted Xian to third-grade office, granted hereditary meng'an; Hou Jin fourth grade; Chen Rong, Xing Jin, Bian Quan, Wei Xing, Sun Zhong all fifth grade; rewards in silver varied.
translations.idiomatic: Xian was raised to rank 3 with hereditary meng'an status; Hou Jin to 4; Chen Rong, Xing Jin, Bian Quan, Wei Xing, and Sun Zhong to 5—with silver rewards apportioned.

sentences.zh: 必蘭阿魯帶

translations.literal: Bilanaludai
translations.idiomatic: Here begins the biography of Bilanaludai.

sentences.zh: 必蘭阿魯帶，貞祐初，累官甯化州刺史。

translations.literal: Bilanaludai—at the beginning of Zhenyou, through successive offices became Prefect of Ninghua.
translations.idiomatic: Bilanaludai rose through the ranks to Ninghua prefect early in Zhenyou.

sentences.zh: 二年，同知真定府事，權河北、大名宣撫副使。

translations.literal: In the second year, Associate Prefect of Zhending, Acting Pacification Vice Commissioner of Hebei and Daming.
translations.idiomatic: In year two he became associate prefect of Zhending and acting Hebei-Daming pacification vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三年，保全贊皇，加遙授安武軍節度使，改昭義軍節度使、充宣撫副使。

translations.literal: In the third year he preserved Zanhuang, was added distantly-commissioned Anwu Army military commissioner, changed to Zhaoyi Army military commissioner and filled pacification vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year three he saved Zanhuang, received a nominal Anwu commission, and became Zhaoyi commissioner while keeping the pacification post.

sentences.zh: 閱月，權元帥左都監行元帥府事，節度、宣撫如故。

translations.literal: Within a month, Acting Marshal Left Chief Overseer conducting marshalate affairs; military commissioner and pacification posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: A month later he became acting chief left overseer running the marshalate, retaining his commissioner titles.

sentences.zh: 遣都統奧屯喜哥複取威州及獲鹿縣。

translations.literal: He sent Commander-in-Chief Aotun Xige to recover again Weizhou and Huolu County.
translations.idiomatic: He sent commander Aotun Xige to retake Weizhou and Huolu.

sentences.zh: 既而詔擇義軍為三等，阿魯帶奏：「自去歲初置帥府，已按閱本軍，去其冗食。

translations.literal: Soon after an edict chose righteous armies in three grades; Bilanaludai memorialized: "Since last year when the marshalate was first established, we have already inspected this army and removed redundant consumption.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the court ordered the militia divided into three grades; Bilanaludai protested: "Since we set up the marshalate last year we have inspected the troops and cut dead weight.

sentences.zh: 部分既定，上下既親，故能所向成功，此皆血戰屢試而可者。

translations.literal: Divisions were settled, above and below were already intimate, therefore able to succeed wherever sent—these are all men blood-battled and repeatedly tested who can be relied on.
translations.idiomatic: With ranks fixed and officers close to their men, they win wherever sent—these are veterans proven in blood.

sentences.zh: 父子兄弟自相救援，各顧其家，心一力齊，勢不可離。

translations.literal: Fathers, sons, and brothers rescue one another; each looks to his family—one heart, joined strength, momentum that cannot be separated.
translations.idiomatic: Fathers, sons, and brothers fight for one another and their households—united in heart and force they cannot be split.

sentences.zh: 今必析之，將互易其處，不相諳委矣。

translations.literal: Now if they must be carved apart, they will exchange places with one another and no longer be mutually acquainted and entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: Split them now and they will swap places without knowing one another.

sentences.zh: 國家糧儲常患不繼，豈容僥冒其間？

translations.literal: The state's grain stores always suffer from failing to continue—how can one permit false claims within them?
translations.idiomatic: State granaries already run dry—how can we tolerate freeloaders in the ranks?

sentences.zh: 但本府之兵不至是耳。

translations.literal: Only this command's troops have not reached that point.
translations.idiomatic: Only our command's troops are not yet at that point.

sentences.zh: 事勢方殷，分別如此，彼居中下，將氣挫心懈而不可用。

translations.literal: The situation is just pressing; to divide thus, those placed in middle and lower will have spirit broken and hearts slackened and cannot be used.
translations.idiomatic: In the present crisis such a split would demoralize the middle and lower ranks and leave them useless.

sentences.zh: 且義軍率皆農民，已散歸田畝，趨時力作，徵集旬日，農事廢而歲計失矣。

translations.literal: Moreover righteous armies are for the most part farmers; they have scattered back to fields, hastening seasonal labor—assemble them for ten days and farm work is abandoned and the year's account is lost.
translations.idiomatic: Most militiamen are farmers already back on their fields—call them up for ten days and the harvest is ruined.

sentences.zh: 乞本府所定，無輕變易。」

translations.literal: I beg what this command has settled—do not lightly change it."
translations.idiomatic: Keep the arrangement our command has set—do not alter it lightly."

sentences.zh: 詔許之。

translations.literal: An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 阿魯帶繕完州縣之可守者，其不可守者遷徙其民，依險為柵以備緩急。

translations.literal: Bilanaludai repaired and completed what prefectures and counties could be defended; what could not be defended he moved the people, relying on perilous ground to make palisades against urgency.
translations.idiomatic: Bilanaludai fortified defensible counties, evacuated the rest, and built mountain stockades for emergencies.

sentences.zh: 澤州舊隸昭義軍，近年改隸孟州，阿魯帶奏：「澤州城郭堅完，器械具備，若屯兵數千，臣能保守之。

translations.literal: Zezhou formerly was subordinate to the Zhaoyi Army; in recent years changed to subordination to Mengzhou; Bilanaludai memorialized: "Zezhou's walls and moats are solid and complete, weapons and equipment provided; if several thousand troops are stationed, your servant can preserve it.
translations.idiomatic: Zezhou once belonged to the Zhaoyi Army but had lately been put under Mengzhou; Bilanaludai wrote: "Zezhou's walls and arsenals are intact—with a few thousand troops I can hold it.

sentences.zh: 今聞議遷於青蓮寺山寨，距州既遠，地形狹隘，所容無幾。

translations.literal: Now I hear discussion of moving to Qinglian Temple mountain stockade—the distance from the prefecture is already far, the terrain narrow and cramped, what it can hold is few.
translations.idiomatic: I hear they mean to move to the Qinglian Temple hill fort—too far, too cramped, and it holds too few.

sentences.zh: 一旦有急，所保者少，所遣者多，徒棄名城以失太行之險，則沁南、昭義不通問矣。」

translations.literal: Once there is urgency, those preserved are few, those dispatched many; in vain abandon a famous city and lose the peril of Taihang—then Qinnan and Zhaoyi would have no communication."
translations.idiomatic: In crisis fewer would be defended while more were exposed; abandoning a great city forfeits Taihang's chokepoint and cuts Qinnan and Zhaoyi off from one another."

sentences.zh: 詔澤州複隸昭義軍。

translations.literal: An edict returned Zezhou to subordination under the Zhaoyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Zezhou was restored to the Zhaoyi Army.

sentences.zh: 是歲，潼關失守，阿魯帶趨備藍田、商州，乃陳河北利害，略曰：「今忻、代撤戍，太原帥府眾才數千，平陽行省兵亦不多，河東、河北之勢，全恃潞州，潞州兵強，則國家基本漸可複立。

translations.literal: That year Tong Pass was lost; Bilanaludai hurried to prepare Lantian and Shangzhou, then set forth the gains and harms of Hebei, broadly: "Now Xin and Dai have withdrawn garrisons, Taiyuan marshalate forces are only several thousand, Pingyang branch secretariat troops also not many—the strategic position of Hedong and Hebei wholly relies on Luzhou; if Luzhou's troops are strong, the state's foundation can gradually be re-established.
translations.idiomatic: That year, when Tong Pass fell, Bilanaludai rushed to secure Lantian and Shangzhou and argued for Hebei: "With garrisons pulled from Xin and Dai, Taiyuan's few thousand troops, and little at Pingyang, Hedong and Hebei hinge on Luzhou—strengthen Luzhou and the dynasty's base can rise again.

sentences.zh: 臣已將兵離境，乞複置潞州帥府。」

translations.literal: Your servant has already led troops beyond the borders—I beg to restore the Luzhou marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: I have already marched beyond the border—I beg the Luzhou marshalate be restored."

sentences.zh: 阿魯帶行次澠池，右副元帥蒲察阿裏不孫敗績，逃匿不知所在。

translations.literal: Bilanaludai on march halted at Mianchi; Right Vice Marshal Pucha Alibusun suffered defeat, fled and hid—whereabouts unknown.
translations.idiomatic: At Mianchi, Bilanaludai learned that right vice marshal Pucha Alibusun had been routed and fled—his whereabouts unknown.

sentences.zh: 阿魯帶亦被創，收集潰卒，臥澠池。

translations.literal: Bilanaludai also was wounded, gathered scattered soldiers, and lay sick at Mianchi.
translations.idiomatic: Bilanaludai too was wounded; he gathered the rout and lay convalescent at Mianchi.

sentences.zh: 詔還潞州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered return to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered back to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：貞祐之時，僕散安貞定山東，僕散端鎮陝西，胥鼎控制河東，侯摯經營趙、魏，其措注施設有可觀者。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: In the time of Zhenyou, Pusan Anzhen secured Shandong, Pusan Duan garrisoned Shaanxi, Xu Ding controlled Hedong, Hou Zhi managed Zhao and Wei—their arrangements and installations had points worth viewing.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal runs: Under Zhenyou, Pusan Anzhen held Shandong, Pusan Duan guarded Shaanxi, Xu Ding controlled Hedong, and Hou Zhi ran Zhao and Wei—their measures still repay study.

sentences.zh: 故田琢撫青、齊，完顏弼保東平，必蘭阿魯帶守上党，皆向用有功焉。

translations.literal: Hence Tian Zhuo pacified Qing and Qi, Wanyan Bi secured Dongping, and Bilanaludai held Shangdang—all were favored in employment and had merit.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Zhuo had pacified Qing and Qi, Wanyan Bi had held Dongping, and Bilanaludai had guarded Shangdang; each had been trusted and had served with distinction.

sentences.zh: 高琪忌功，汝礪固位，西啟夏釁，南挑宋兵。

translations.literal: Gao Qi envied merit, Ru Li cemented his position, opened strife with Xia in the west, and provoked Song troops in the south.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qi resented others' achievements while Ru Li clung to office; they stirred trouble with Xia in the west and goaded the Song in the south.

sentences.zh: 宣宗道謀是用，煦煦以為慈，皦皦以為明，孑孑以為強。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong used their counsel, taking gentle warmth for compassion, bright clarity for wisdom, and solitary vigor for strength.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong followed their advice, mistaking mere warmth for true kindness, surface brightness for real insight, and showy resolve for genuine strength.

sentences.zh: 既而潼關破毀，崤、澠喪敗，汴州城門不啟連月，高琪方且增陴浚隍為自守計，繕禦寨以祈逃死。

translations.literal: Then Tong Pass was broken and destroyed, Xiao and Mian suffered defeat, Bianzhou's gates did not open for months, while Gao Qi was raising walls and deepening moats for self-defense and building defense forts to beg escape from death.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Tong Pass lay in ruins, the Xiao and Mian fronts collapsed, and the gates of Bianzhou stayed shut for months while Gao Qi busied himself thickening walls and digging moats to hold the capital and threw up redoubts in the hope of outliving the siege.

sentences.zh: 然後田琢走益都而青、齊裂，蒙古綱去東平而兗、魯蹙，僕散安貞死而南伐無功。

translations.literal: Then Tian Zhuo fled to Yidu and Qing and Qi split apart, Meng Gugang left Dongping and Yan and Lu were pressed, Pusan Anzhen died and southern campaigns achieved no merit.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did Tian Zhuo flee to Yidu as Qing and Qi came apart, Meng Gugang abandon Dongping as Yan and Lu tightened, and Pusan Anzhen die with the southern expeditions yielding nothing.

sentences.zh: 雖曰天道，亦由人事。

translations.literal: Although one may speak of Heaven's way, it also lay in human affairs.
translations.idiomatic: One may call it the mandate of Heaven, yet it was human choice as well.

sentences.zh: 自是以往，無足言者矣。

translations.literal: From this point onward, there is nothing more worth saying.
translations.idiomatic: After that, there is little left worth recounting.
